metadata.question: Does the water 100 km south of Bear Island, Norway show more milky turquoise-blue color than that 250 km south of Bear Island on August 5, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search Strategy**: - Bear Island (Bjørnøya) is located at approximately 74.5°N, 19.0°E - 100 km south: ~70.5°N, 19.0°E - 250 km south: ~67.0°N, 19.0°E - Date: August 5, 2025 (future date - this is problematic, but I'll attempt the query) - Use Sentinel-2 for high-resolution true color/RGB analysis - Milky turquoise-blue color indicates suspended sediment (high reflectance in visible bands, characteristic of glacial meltwater or fine sediment) 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Minimize cloud masking to preserve actual water color signatures - Use true color RGB composite to visually assess "milky turquoise" characteristics - Calculate a proxy metric: high visible reflectance (B2, B3, B4 bands) with low NIR suggests sediment-laden water - A simple "turquoise index" can be: (B2 + B3) / B4, where higher values suggest lighter/more milky appearance 3. **Logic to Distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - If no Sentinel-2 images available for August 5, 2025 → C1 (future date, likely no data) - If images exist but are cloud-covered → may still have pixels - Compare reflectance ratios between two points - If calculation yields valid numbers: compare (A if location1 > location2, B otherwise) - If either location has 0 valid pixels after processing → C2 - If invalid results (NaN, None, out of physical bounds) → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Bear Island and two points south const bearIsland = ee.Geometry.Point([19.0, 74.5]); const point100kmS = ee.Geometry.Point([19.0, 70.5]); // ~100 km south const point250kmS = ee.Geometry.Point([19.0, 67.0]); // ~250 km south // Buffer to 5 km radius for sampling const buffer100 = point100kmS.buffer(5000); const buffer250 = point250kmS.buffer(5000); // Date range (August 5, 2025 - future date) const dateStart = '2025-08-05'; const dateEnd = '2025-08-06'; // Sentinel-2 collection (L2A - bottom of atmosphere reflectance) let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(point100kmS.buffer(300000)) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); // Allow some clouds for future date const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found (Aug 5, 2025): ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for August 5, 2025 (future date or no coverage)'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Mosaic images for the date const img = col.median(); // Select visible bands (B2=Blue, B3=Green, B4=Red) for true color const vis = img.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); // Calculate turquoise index: (B2 + B3) / B4 // Higher values = lighter, more "milky" water (sediment-laden) const turquoiseIndex = img.select('B2').add(img.select('B3')).divide(img.select('B4')); // Measure 1: Mean turquoise index at 100 km south const stats100 = turquoiseIndex.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: buffer100, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val100 = stats100.B2_B3_B4_mean; const count100 = stats100.B2_B3_B4_count; console.log(`100 km south - Turquoise Index: ${val100?.toFixed(3) || 'N/A'}, Pixels: ${count100 || 0}`); if (count100 === 0 || count100 === undefined) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Measure 2: Mean turquoise index at 250 km south const stats250 = turquoiseIndex.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: buffer250, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const val250 = stats250.B2_B3_B4_mean; const count250 = stats250.B2_B3_B4_count; console.log(`250 km south - Turquoise Index: ${val250?.toFixed(3) || 'N/A'}, Pixels: ${count250 || 0}`); if (count250 === 0 || count250 === undefined) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Validation if (val100 === null || val100 === undefined || isNaN(val100) || val250 === null || val250 === undefined || isNaN(val250)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: higher turquoise index = milkier/lighter color (more sediment) const comparison = val100 > val250; console.log(`Comparison: 100km (${val100.toFixed(3)}) > 250km (${val250.toFixed(3)}) = ${comparison}`); if (comparison) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
